source.title: Reified class type parameters are not enforced inside union alternatives at reflective writes

reverification.probe: `Keeper[int].set("slot", ["a", "b"])` into `var slot: Array[T] | int` is accepted and the slot holds `["a", "b"]` (FS_TEST_OK on both corpus passes).

rationale: This is a union-destination escape, but its source needs a type-parameter alternative the family's source_proof axis cannot spell; the axis is added with the family's adapter registration, and the seed lands then.
